sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731: Specs, Pricing, Benchmarks and API Update ...
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-V4-Flash is a 284B-total, 13B-active MoE model with a 1M-token context window and up to 384K output tokens. The V4 family uses a hybrid attention architecture combining Compressed Sparse Attention and Heavily Compressed Attention, together with mHC connections and the Muon optimizer.
